_doc: Coordinates: tiles. Arena is 18 wide x 32 tall; y=0 is the side-0 (bottom) king tower edge.
Speeds in tiles/second (game speed 60 = 1.0 tile/s). Times in seconds here; the engine converts to integer ms.

base_stats = stats at the rarity's first level, exactly as stored in the game files. stat(L) = floor(base * multiplier_pct[L-1-rarity_offset] / 100). Verified exact on all 4,945 per-level values in the RoyaleAPI data.
Cards are filled by `python -m backend_engine.simulator.sync_meta`. data_as_of shows how old the balance numbers are; verified=true only after checking the live game.
Hero/Champion abilities (Aug 2026 patch): single-use, no cooldown, except Boss Bandit. Schema: ability = {name, elixir, uses: 1, cooldown_s: null}.
Schema 4: identity (internal_name = game sc_key, game_id, aliases) and variants {evo, hero} live inside the base card; mechanics are [{kind, params}] resolved by backend_engine/simulator/mechanics.

level_scaling._source: RoyaleAPI cr-api-data rarities.json power_level_multiplier (game files); hero offset unknown
